events.verdict: Vucevic (ORL) briefly makes contact with the ball, allowing Gasol (MEM) to reestablish his pivot foot.
Evans (MEM) legally contests Ross' (ORL) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Fournier (ORL) is in a legal guarding position and deflects the ball away from Gasol (MEM).
Gasol (MEM) and Mack (ORL) make incidental contact with one another during the loose ball.
Vucevic (ORL) makes marginal contact with Gasol (MEM) that does not affect his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Fournier (ORL) lifts his pivot foot at the start of the dribble.
Ross (ORL) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Chalmers (MEM) that does not affect his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Fournier (ORL) makes marginal contact with Chalmers (MEM) on his driving shot attempt.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of Magic possession is confirmed.
Vucevic (ORL) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Chalmers (MEM) that does not affect his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Gasol (MEM) sets the screen on Simmons (ORL) and gives him room to avoid the contact. Gasol makes marginal contact with Simmons following the screen.
Brooks (MEM) commits a take foul on Simmons (ORL).
Brooks (MEM) grabs and holds Vucevic (ORL) and the contact affects his FOM.
Evans (MEM) commits a take foul on Ross (ORL).
